title: Order Response Enumerations
description: Vocabularies for messages a consumer (e.g. Computyme) sends back about an order it received. Same governance as the order contract: string semantics, additive evolution, never repurpose a member.

ResponseType.description: What kind of response this message is. Determines which payload fields are meaningful.

AckResult.description: Outcome of receiving the order, returned immediately. ACCEPTED = valid, will process; REJECTED = will not; ACCEPTED_WITH_CHANGES = processing but flagged deviations.

RejectReason.description: Why an order was rejected. Present only when ackResult is REJECTED.

LineResponseStatus.description: Per-line outcome reported back by the consumer.
